children: VanEck BNB ETF reported activity for the period ended June 30, 2026, registering a net decrease in net assets from operations of $(309,637) and a net asset value (NAV) of $2.14M as of June 30, 2026, up from $100000 at launch in November 2025.
Net income: $(309.6K) net decrease in net assets from operations for the period ended June 30, 2026 (net unrealized depreciation $(308.9K) and net investment loss $(0.7K)).
NAV: $2.14M at June 30, 2026, compared with $100K at Nov 14, 2025 (increase of 2,040.75%).
NAV per share: $21.41 per share at June 30, 2026 (period high $26.95 on June 1, 2026; down 14.36% from $25.00 on May 7, 2026).
Seed capital and launch: A seed investor provided an initial $100K and an additional $1M in May 2026, enabling initial BNB purchases and activation of the trust.
Asset growth & share creation: Outstanding shares expanded from 4,000 to 100,000, driving NAV growth and scaling operations.
Primary liquidity source: Trust liquidity is sourced mainly through BNB sales; the Sponsor covers most operating expenses under a fee agreement.
NAV pricing & valuation: NAV is calculated daily using the MarketVector™ BNB Benchmark Rate to mitigate exchange risk and deter manipulation.
Operational activity & staking: The trust began staking BNB after investment; the Sponsor may increase staking if legal and regulatory conditions permit.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
